instantiated_cells.justification: Section 305.003(a)(2) requires registration if a person receives/ is entitled to receive compensation or reimbursement of more than an amount set by commission rule but not less than $200 in a calendar quarter for direct communication to influence legislation or administrative action.

Section 305.003(a)(1) requires registration if a person makes total expenditures in a calendar quarter of an amount set by commission rule but not less than $200 on covered lobbying-communication activities.

The reporting provisions require totals by category and only add detail when certain thresholds are exceeded (e.g., >$50 gifts; >60% per diem for food/entertainment/transportation), but they do not create a de minimis per-item threshold below which an expenditure need not be reported at all.

Once a person is a registrant, Section 305.006(a) requires each registrant to file an activities report, and the statute provides no exemption from filing based solely on having total lobbying expenditures below a stated de minimis amount.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The bundled text includes an hours-based time exemption (Tex. Gov't Code §305.003(b-3)) but does not define any exemption based on a percentage of an individual's compensated time, which this cell specifically asks for.
